headline: Machado Returns to Venezuela as US Administration Eyes Access to Oil Reserves
summary: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado has returned to Venezuela following the capture of Nicolás Maduro by US forces, as the Trump administration works to open the country's oil reserves.
why: Venezuela holds the world's largest proven crude oil reserves, making shifts in its political authority crucial for global energy markets and sanctions frameworks.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Prospects of Venezuelan crude production reopening increase expectations for long-term global petroleum supply.

impacts.name: Venezuela
impacts.why: A potential regime transition and opening of energy reserves could fundamentally shift the national economic trajectory.

why_moved: Anticipation of resumed foreign access to Venezuelan oil reserves fuels expectations of eventual increases in international crude supplies.
